recipes.name: Lemon Tahini Dressing
ingredients: ¼ cup (60 mL) freshly squeezed lemon juice
1 fat clove garlic, (grated or very finely minced)
¼ teaspoon kosher salt, (plus more as needed)
¼ cup (56g) extra virgin olive oil ((see Note 3))
instructions: In a wide-mouth jar for which you have a lid (or a bowl), combine the lemon juice, vinegar, tahini, Dijon mustard, garlic, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to taste. Whisk well to combine.
Now stream in the olive oil, whisking as you go, until emulsified. NOTE: If it feels too thick, whisk in cold water, one tablespoon at a time.
Taste, adding more salt as desired. For more acidity, add more lemon juice or vinegar. For sweetness or balance, add more maple syrup.
Store in a sealed jar in the fridge for 7 to 10 days. It will thicken, so stream in some cold water, whisk, and continue you reach your desired consistency.

page_recipe_notes: Notes My preferred tahini brands: Al Kanater , Beirut , and Al Arz . The sweetener helps balance the acidity from the vinegar and lemon, but if you prefer less sweet things, start with 1 teaspoon. If you want to make this dressing without oil or with less oil, check out the first FAQ .
